items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I had started writing then, with Joe Garland and Rudy Powell and all those guys in the band... we had sort of a quartet, with Rudy Powell, clarinet... I played the vibes, along with Rudy Powell.

ctx.x: Well, Joe Garland -- well, I had started writing then, with Joe Garland and Rudy Powell and all those guys in the band. They just taught me --
Oh, that's where it all began.
